payload.body: Wave 1 remediation merged green (45 findings): crypto/E2EE (core 118), auth+SAML (server 1135), Swift client (174), Android client (encrypt-at-rest + decode bounds + hung-deferred drains), storage atomicity/isolation, blob-GC data-loss hardening. Integrated gate: typecheck 0, server 1135, core 118, swift 174, android :frick/:frick-compose green.
